title: Rincon Ocean Harmony Apartment 1
description: Relax and slow down in paradise! Our charming apartment offers breathtaking ocean views and is just a 3-minute walk to world-class beaches where you can soak up the sun. You'll also find some of the area’s best restaurants a similar short walk away, making dining out a breeze. Nestled in a peaceful neighborhood, you’ll enjoy the soothing sounds of the ocean right from your home. Apartment has a fully equipped kitchen, 1 queen bed, 1 futon, fully equipped kitchen, internet, & parking.The spaceSome places you visit. Others you never want to leave.Ocean Harmony 1 is a brand-new, modern private apartment where the ocean isn’t just a view — it’s part of your daily experience. Wake up to the sound of waves, feel the Caribbean breeze come through your windows, and step onto a shared terrace with one of the most beautiful ocean views in Rincón.Located in Puntas — the most exclusive and sought-after neighborhood on Puerto Rico’s west coast — you’re steps from the beach, iconic restaurants, world-class surf breaks, and the kind of sunsets that make you forget everything else.This is not just a place to sleep. This is your Rincón.Two couples? Book both apartments — your own private space, shared terrace, unforgettable trip

title: La Casita del Mar

images.caption: Unwind on your private porch with two cozy chairs, the perfect spot to soak in the warm breeze of Rincón. Start your mornings with coffee or end your day with a sunset, all just minutes from the beach and town.

description: LOCATION! La Casita is located in the heart of Rincón, Puerto Rico, just a 3-minute walk to town filled with restaurants, shops, and local culture. This cozy 2-bedroom, 1-bath home is also minutes from the beach, whether you prefer a quick stroll or short drive. Enjoy a full kitchen, comfortable living space, laundry, and a relaxing front porch. There are 4 AC units - each bedroom, kitchen, and the living room. There’s also a shared grill area, perfect for unwinding after a day in the sun.The spaceYour private casita is located on a main road just a short 3 minute walk to the heart of town. The casita offers unbeatable convenience to shops, dining, and local attractions. As with many central locations, you may notice some evening noise, so we’ve thoughtfully provided sound machines in each bedroom to help ensure a restful night’s sleep.Inside, you’ll find two spacious bedrooms with queen beds, ample closet space, and a full bathroom. The cozy living area is perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach.The fully equipped kitchen includes a refrigerator, stovetop, microwave, toaster, air fryer, coffee maker, blender, rice cooker, and all essential cookware. A dining area for four offers a comfortable space to enjoy meals together. For added convenience, the home also features a washer and dryer to make longer stays easy and stress-free.The property features two homes. Guests will enjoy one designated parking space, along with access to a shared outdoor area equipped with a grill, perfect for relaxing and enjoying meals after a day exploring Rincón.Guest accessLa Casita is a private fully equipped house with its own entrance and porch for morning coffee.The grill and hammock area are shared. These are located under the carport with two ceiling fans. A great way to unwind outside, relax reading a book, and cook meals.Other things to noteThe are beach chairs, beach umbrella and a cooler for the beach.

title: La Casa Azul Private: Pool/Cacao tour/Grill
description: La Casa Azul is located on the west coast of Puerto Rico, between the towns of Aguada and Rincón.Our house has five (5) cozy rooms with private bathrooms and air conditioning, an excellent private pool area, a cocoa and vanilla plantation where we do the chocolate tour.We are minutes from the beaches of Rincón and Aguadilla and the best tourist attractions in the west coast. Also we do a variety of cultural tours!We will help you discover the island with the Puertorican hospitality.The spaceCasa Azul has a relaxing, tropical and Caribbean atmosphere.Our rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable with a rustic touch.Our decoration has a Creole style, typical of Caribbean country houses.The house is built in the middle of the 20th century, being one of the oldest wooden houses in our community. In the past, sugar cane was grown in its surroundings; but today we grow cocoa.The Casa Azul space is designed to make you feel comfortable and as a family.The rooms have air conditioning, private bathroom, comfortable closets, towels, sheets and toiletries.All the walls of our house have works of art by local artists.We have a beautiful terrace and balconies with comfortable benches, chairs, hammocks and tables where you can have breakfast, read a book or just relax while contemplating the garden.In our room we have a variety of board games, a smart TV with integrated Wi-Fi and the option of local channels, comfortable blue armchairs and Creole chairs for a unique cultural touch.The dining room has a large table and an island-bar.The kitchen is fully equipped with stove, sink, microwave, coffee maker, refrigerator, kitchen equipment, plates, cups, cutlery, glasses and everything you need so you can prepare your own meals before or after exploring.For the benefit of all visitors we have an information table; where you will find information and brochures on the best restaurants, beaches, waterfalls, agrotours, museums, parks and all the places to visit and discover near us.In the garden we have a large patio and an excellent pool area. In front of the pool you will see our small square with chairs, tables and umbrellas. You will also find the gazebo with the grill and shower and bathroom area of ​​the pool.We have an additional two other gazebos with hammocks to enjoy the outdoors while you relax.In our garden will find signs with information about our biodiversity, you will see hammocks, butterflies spot, orchid garden and fish ponds y all areas. The garden is perfect for bird watching, connecting with nature and doing yoga.Inside the Cacao plantación we have more than 100 cacao trees that produce the material to make our chocolate bars.Stay with us and enjoy paradise!.Guest accessThroughout our house we have high-speed Wi-Fi; Perfect for watching netflix on our smart TV, studying or working while on vacation.We provide towels, shower items, toilet paper and garbage bags. If during your stay you need more of these resources, feel free to ask us.The kitchen area is fully equipped with all the appliances so you can cook your favorite dishes. We always have sugar, coffee and tea available for our guests at the house.In the patio area we have three comfortable gazebos. We also have a grill area and campfire area in our forest. We have all the equipment to make your barbecue.We have a disabled ramp in the house that gives access to our second level and the pool area.The pool area has a small plaza with a variety of comfortable tables and chairs. It has spaces to put the towel and take a delicious sunbath. It also has its shower and bathroom area. It can be used at any time, being the hours of the waterfall from 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.In the room you will find an information table with lists of museums, parks, taxis, forests, agrotours, beaches, restaurants and all the places to visit near Casa Azul.We are in a central location between the towns of Aguada, Rincón and Aguadilla. So we are the perfect spot for surfers and adventurers who like to explore our island.The beaches of all the towns of the northwest are equidistant to us. So driving between 6 and 18 minutes you will find very good paradisiacal beaches.We are also very close to museums, monuments, restaurants, forests and waterfalls!Our Cocoa Tour lasts one hour and the time to offer it during the stay is coordinated with us.Tour hours are Monday through Friday from 4:00pm-5:00pm and weekends from 10:00-11:00amAsk us about our variety of private tours exploring Aguada and other western towns.Inside our house we also have free private parking.Do not forget to enjoy a sit, drink coffee or read a book in the more than 8 hammocks scattered throughout our gazebos and gardens.Other things to noteBlue House experiences.At Casa Azul you will find a variety of activities that you can do in coordination with us that will make your stay unique, varied and fun.Cocoa Tour.Our House has a cocoa farm where we produce handmade chocolate.The tour lasts one hour.Schedules:10:00-11:00 a.m.11:00-12:00pm5:00 p.m.-6:00 p.m.Cost: $25 per person.We learn about the history, cultivation and processing of cocoa and we include a tasting of our artisan chocolate.Visit our Private museum.We are certified tourist guides and as part of our offer we have a visit to our private museum.The visit lasts 35 minutes and includes a tour of 5 rooms of antiques, art, and carvings that tell the story of the towns of western Puerto Rico.Cost: $10 per person.Tour of Aguada.The tour lasts 2 hours.We explore some of the emblematic places of the town of Aguada while we walk through the historic center. Cost: $40 per person.Blue House Rules.Each space has a maximum number of guests. Additional guests not notified will be charged an extra $25 per person per night.Smoking is not allowed inside the house or in the rooms. We have a dedicated area in one of our gazebos. Smoking inside the home will incur a $100 cleaning fee to remove the odor.Pets are not allowed on the property, except those that are service.If you bring pets, there will be a $40 pet fee.We have a water tank and electric generator in the house so you should not worry if any of the basic services are interrupted in the town.The pool area can be used at any time. The motor and waterfall hours are from 9:00 am to 7:00 pm.Please do not eat or drink in or around the pool.Do not run or dive in the pool.In the pool area there is an external shower that can be used to wash the sand in case you come from the beach.Check in will always be at 4:00 pm. If you need to arrive earlier, you must notify us in advance and it will be subject to the availability of your space.Late departure.Check out is at 12:00 noon or earlier.Late departure must be notified in advance and will be subject to space availability.An additional fee of $20 will be charged for each additional hour after 12:00 noon.The house is exclusively for guests. No strangers or visitors are allowed within the Casa Azul premises from anyone who is not a Casa Azul guest or employee.Loud noises, shouting and loud music are prohibited at night. This is for the benefit of all guests and the community.If you are going to use our campfire area or you are going to use the grill, remember to turn it off after use and dispose of the ashes in the nearest garbage can. The guests must buy the charcoal.Only Casa Azul guests can use the pool area.Our staff is always ready to help
